native_entry_points.binding_rule: module-relative exact-build addresses are immutable inputs to the private integration adapter; every address must match the pinned RVA set

ranked_row_layout.ordering: preserve native scored-row order and native rank

private_adapter_contract.ranked_source: read_ranked_candidates invokes the pinned native enumerate and score/filter path for the subject strategy and copies no more than eight full IDs and total scores
private_adapter_contract.pair_evaluation: evaluate_candidate constructs and finalizes the direct five-role marriage context, then consumes pinned complete Can Send, raw ai_accept, special-aware outer answer and native outcome classification
private_adapter_contract.subject_scope: direct played-character matchmaking only; subject and matchmaker are the same full CharacterID
private_adapter_contract.entry_point_ownership: the private core validates and passes exact-build entry points; native owner/context construction remains the next isolated integration package
private_adapter_contract.pointer_policy: native pointers and strategy/context owners are transient adapter inputs and are never serialized

recapture and compare the paused frame
